rules.reason: Tessera's terms (3.1(c)) exclude US persons from using Tessera, including its smart contracts, so a US holder cannot redeem.
Germany is not an excluded jurisdiction, and any holder, including someone who bought on the secondary market, may redeem during the Redemption Period. KYC is required only when lending (minting).

Tessera excludes FATF grey-listed jurisdictions and links to the June 2025 list, which still included Nigeria. FATF removed Nigeria on 24 October 2025. Whether Tessera will serve a Nigerian holder at redemption is unclear; ask Tessera before relying on it.
Redemption opens only after the issuer receives the proceeds of a liquidity event such as an IPO, and runs for 90 days. After that the claim lapses and the issuer is released (terms 2.2).

SpaceX listed on 12 June 2026, but the window opens only once the issuer has actually received sale proceeds, which can follow a lock-up. Vestail found no announced Redemption Start Date for T-SpaceX.
